summary.text: Brad Noll is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 92, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Michael Hite.
A retired manufacturing worker and lifelong Berkeley County resident, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his concerns include taxation and fees, the cost of living and property rights.

paragraphs.text: Brad Noll said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that he is a lifetime resident of Berkeley County, West Virginia, living in the Tomahawk area, and graduated from Hedgesville High School.
He said he earned an Associate in Science degree at Glenville State College and worked in manufacturing for 38 years before retiring.
Noll said he wants to fight unnecessary taxation and bring more tax relief to seniors and landowners.
He said the Eastern Panhandle needs a locality pay system because of unfilled public service positions, and that the area's roads need improvement.
He also said that HB 2014 forfeited local controls and gave tax incentives to data centers.
